name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0) - Maternity Benefit
benefit: Cash maternity benefit via DBT to the mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank/post office account: Rs 5,000 for the FIRST living child in two installments (Rs 3,000 after pregnancy registration and at least one antenatal check-up; Rs 2,000 after birth registration and completion of the 14-week immunization cycle). For the SECOND child, Rs 6,000 in a single installment after birth and immunization, ONLY if the second child is a girl (PMMVY 2.0 provision to promote the girl child, effective 01/04/2022). Institutional delivery additionally qualifies for the Janani Suraksha Yojana incentive, taking the first-child total to about Rs 6,000 on average. If twins/triplets are born in the second pregnancy and any is a girl, the benefit for one second girl child applies.
eligibility_rules: Pregnant women and lactating mothers, for the first two living children (second child benefit only if the second child is a girl)

Must belong to a socially/economically disadvantaged category - ANY ONE of the following qualifies: SC or ST women; women partially (40%) or fully disabled (Divyangjan); women holding a ration card under NFSA 2013; beneficiaries of PM-JAY/Ayushman Bharat; women with net family income below Rs 8,00,000 per annum; and other categories notified by the government (e.g. MGNREGA job card, e-Shram registration, BPL)
Aadhaar of the beneficiary is mandatory (Mission Shakti / Aadhaar Act provision) along with an Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account
For the second-child (girl) benefit, registration during the pregnancy is mandatory
Application must be made within 270 days of childbirth
Cases of miscarriage or stillbirth are treated as fresh cases for a future pregnancy
exclusions: Women in regular employment with the Central Government, State Government or PSUs are not eligible
Women already receiving similar maternity benefits under any law (e.g. paid maternity leave) are not eligible
Second child benefit is NOT available if the second child is a boy
Benefit applies only to the first two living children; third and subsequent children are not covered
If the child does not survive after the beneficiary has claimed all installments, she is not eligible for the benefit again for future pregnancies
The scheme is not implemented in Telangana and Odisha (they run their own maternity schemes) - not relevant for Maharashtra users
documents_required: MCP Card (Mother and Child Protection card)
Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account details
Proof of eligibility category (e.g. caste certificate, ration card, PM-JAY card, income proof, disability certificate - any one)
For second installment: child's birth registration certificate and immunization record (BCG, OPV, DPT/IPV, Hepatitis-B)
how_to_apply: Three ways: (1) self-register online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in via Citizen Login with mobile OTP; (2) through the PMMVY mobile app; (3) ask the local Anganwadi Worker or ASHA worker to fill the application - they do this free of cost. Helpline: 1515 (9am-6pm), email pmmvy-mwcd@gov.in.
source_document: myScheme PMMVY page; PIB; Ministry of Women and Child Development PMMVY 2.0 / Mission Shakti guidelines (w.e.f. 01/04/2022)
